name: reallyme-wallet-core
role: EUDI wallet core domain and runtime library
in_scope: headless issuance and presentation state machines
user-visible transaction and QTSP decision logs
optional render adapters for wallet distribution artifacts
out_of_scope: private key bytes and cryptographic primitive implementations
protocol wire ownership already held by OpenID4VCI and OpenID4VP crates
credential envelope parsing owned by reallyme/ssi
product-facing Swift, Kotlin/Android, and TypeScript package facades owned by identity

dependency_boundaries.name: reallyme-crypto
dependency_boundaries.relationship: transitive cryptographic implementation below SSI and protocol crates

dependency_boundaries.name: reallyme/ssi
dependency_boundaries.relationship: Credential, trust, status, and disclosure semantics composed by Wallet and the protocol crates

dependency_boundaries.name: reallyme-openid4vci
dependency_boundaries.relationship: OpenID4VCI protocol primitives and holder sequencing below wallet-core

dependency_boundaries.name: reallyme-openid4vp
dependency_boundaries.relationship: OpenID4VP verifier and wallet format handling below wallet-core

dependency_boundaries.name: reallyme-zk-api
dependency_boundaries.relationship: trait-only zk circuit registry and prover/verifier boundary
